name: scraper-root
description: Development Root Workspace for LinkedIn Clipper Project

scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix apps/crawler && npm run lint --prefix apps/viewer && cd apps/ebook && .venv/bin/python -m poethepoet lint && cd apps/wiki && uv run ruff check src/worker/ src/web/
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix apps/crawler && npm run format --prefix apps/viewer && cd apps/ebook && .venv/bin/python -m poethepoet format
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check --prefix apps/crawler && npm run type-check --prefix apps/viewer && cd apps/ebook && .venv/bin/python -m poethepoet type-check && cd apps/wiki && uv run mypy src/worker/ src/web/
